why: The correct answer depends on knowing which metallurgical operation each named process is (cyanide process for gold extraction, froth floatation for dressing sulphide ores, electrolytic reduction for aluminium, zone refining for ultrapure germanium), and no chapter in the supplied list teaches extraction metallurgy.
note: TAXONOMY GAP: I expected 'General Principles and Processes of Isolation of Elements' (Metallurgy) -- concentration of ores, froth floatation, leaching/cyanide process, electrolytic and thermal reduction, refining methods (zone refining, van Arkel, Mond). The Chemistry list of 27 chapters has no metallurgy chapter at all; The p-Block Elements and The D- and F-Block Elements are the nearest, but neither teaches these processes.
